title: Uruguayan Serrano Ham Wrap
description: A Japanese-inspired wrap using Uruguayan ham and crispy serrano ham, perfect for a quick snack.
instructions: Place the Uruguayan Serrano ham slices on a baking sheet and bake for 5 minutes to crisp.
Wrap the tortilla in a dry towel and microwave for 20 seconds to warm.
Place the crispy Uruguayan Serrano ham on the tortilla.
Add the crisp-fried ham on top.
Sprinkle sesame seeds around the ham.
Drizzle with soy sauce for dipping.
Fold the tortilla to enclose the filling.
Cut the wrap into halves and serve.
